title: Income-tax Act — Section 17 (Salary, perquisite and profits in lieu of salary)

content.overview: Section 17 defines salary, perquisite, and profits in lieu of salary for the head Salaries.
content.glance: Section 17 defines salary, perquisite, and profits in lieu of salary for the head Salaries.
content.study: Salary includes wages, annuity, pension, gratuity, fees, commission, perquisites, and profits in lieu of salary. Perquisite and profits in lieu of salary are defined in section 17(2) and 17(3).
